item.title: Anders Hejlsberg - Yes, Typescript can be as fast as Rust
MicroLighter: A 2KB Syntax Highlighter That Doesn't Touch the DOM
item.description: I made a smol client-side syntax highlighter that uses the CSS Custom Highlights API called MicroLighter. I’ll talk about why I made it in a bit but first I wanted to… ahem… highlight… some of the features. (2 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)

item.title: CSS Custom Highlights API
item.description: The CSS Custom Highlight API provides a mechanism for styling arbitrary text ranges on a document by using JavaScript to create the ranges, and CSS to style them. (2 sources: frontendfocus, javascriptweekly)
